world.name: NonlinearParentWorld-v1
world.generator: For every action and each of 8 output bits, seeded RNG chooses 3 DISTINCT arbitrary causal input parents. A random 8-entry Boolean truth table is rejected unless all three input parents can change the output in at least one context. Actual public state transition independently executes these hidden truth tables, no code-level access to learner.
world.original_authorship: New locally authored auditable research simulator, NOT external physical dynamics. Freeze source with SHA before first use.

cohorts.train_source: For EACH world/action use 192 distinct seeded random public initial states sampled WITHOUT replacement from 0..255. Observations are actual env.step and globally interleaved by input index -> world -> action, to test competing updates. CHECK and DEV worlds get equal 192/action public source calibration; NO heldout chain outcomes before predictions.
cohorts.heldout_states: Predefined per-world generated random 8-bit start, reject any source label reuse as whole composed sequence; score terminal exact state of 3/5 action chains, execute all real public action steps after all models commit prediction.

frozen_primary.bounded: R7 >=60/64 exact terminal states across 4 previously unseen DEV worlds, >=12 exact each, at least +24 exact over no composition, and complete source identity and 2-process non-timing science agreement.
frozen_primary.novelty: At least +2 exact DEV successes relative to equally informed exhaustive-triple conventional and no worse measured train+prediction cost and checkpoint bytes; any exact tie = NO NATIVE ARCHITECTURAL SUPERIORITY.
frozen_primary.source_gate: All 192 unique original public intervention states per operator per world and exact equal source experience for native/conventional, no hidden parent and no heldout sequence before freeze.
frozen_primary.negative_required: If structural parity persists, recommend stopping more micro-world variants and migrating effort to new empirical learning problems.

costs: Measure fit wall by model, prediction wall per method, serial checkpoint bytes, total process CPU/peak RSS; no power/FLOPs claim.
